packs.reviewer_note: Shipping Container, a close-quarters cargo deck map built with dc-mapkit from the owner's top view. Owner approved 2026-11-02. Adds only a map. Surfaces are ROM texture paths; the pack's pictures are plain name cards with no ROM pixels. Source stays outside this repository (CLEANROOM.md section 4).

Freight Hall, a small 3v3 warehouse built with dc-mapkit from the owner's drawing. Owner approved 2026-11-04. Adds only a map. Models and textures are NVIDIA SimReady (CC BY 4.0, listed in CREDITS.txt), the graffiti our own, no game files. Source in examples/mapkit/freight_hall. Needs clients and servers with credited packs and the 32 MiB limit (MOD-28, MOD-29).

Inspect for the G36E and the L96A1 (and so their camos), owner approved 2026-11-04. Adds inspect poses only (CLI-1845): drawn on the player's own screen, no stat or sound changes, cancelled by firing, reloading or switching. Our own poses, no game files. Source in examples/mods/inspect_g36e_l96a1. Needs clients with weapon inspect (6664ad1b or later).
